Name: Maono Mic Mute
Description: Mute and unmute a Maono USB microphone with a key press, the same way Maono Link does. The key shows whether the microphone is muted.

Actions.Name: Toggle Mute
Actions.Tooltip: Mute or unmute the Maono microphone; the key shows whether it is muted

Localization.Maono Link mutes exactly like its own mu: Maono Link mutes exactly like its own mute button. USB (direct) talks to the microphone itself, so it works even when Maono Link is closed.
Localization.While Maono Link is showing the micropho: While Maono Link is showing the microphone it holds it, so the USB method is busy then; the key falls back to the other method.
Localization.No way to mute the microphone is availab: No way to mute the microphone is available.
Localization.Could not change the mute of the microph: Could not change the mute of the microphone.
